title: [YSQL][randgen] Bitmap Scan plan causes "unexpected postmaster exit" fatal error
body:
Jira Link: [DB-10992](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-10992)
### Description

Problem
---
* The postmaster process disappears immediately when the query is executed, and the client executing the query freezes until its server process is killed or it gets cleaned up after restarting the cluster. No client can make connection until the postmaster is restarted.
```
YB test# /*+ Set(enable_seqscan OFF) Set(enable_hashagg OFF) */ SELECT col_int_nokey AS field1, pk AS field2 FROM CC AS table1 WHERE ( ( ( table1.col_varchar_key LIKE 'c%' AND table1.col_varchar_key NOT IN ('v') ) OR table1.col_varchar_key LIKE 'c%' ) OR table1.col_varchar_key IS NULL );
FATAL:  Connection terminated unexpectedly due to unknown session 386
server closed the connection unexpectedly
	This probably means the server terminated abnormally
	before or while processing the request.
The connection to the server was lost. Attempting reset: Succeeded.
psql (15.6 (Homebrew), server 11.2-YB-2.23.0.0-b0)
YB test#
```
* An error is reported in the postgres-xxx.log: `FATAL:  terminating connection due to unexpected postmaster exit`
* Reproducible on a recent master (42add04f18).


The plan:
```
                                                                                                                   QUERY PLAN
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 YB Bitmap Table Scan on cc table1
   Storage Filter: ((((col_varchar_key)::text ~~ 'c%'::text) AND ((col_varchar_key)::text <> 'v'::text)) OR ((col_varchar_key)::text ~~ 'c%'::text) OR (col_varchar_key IS NULL))
   ->  BitmapOr
         ->  Bitmap Index Scan on cc_int_datetime_varchar_key
               Index Cond: (((col_varchar_key)::text >= 'c'::text) AND ((col_varchar_key)::text < 'd'::text))
               Storage Index Filter: (((col_varchar_key)::text <> 'v'::text) AND ((((col_varchar_key)::text ~~ 'c%'::text) AND ((col_varchar_key)::text <> 'v'::text)) OR ((col_varchar_key)::text ~~ 'c%'::text) OR (col_varchar_key IS NULL)))
         ->  Bitmap Index Scan on cc_int_datetime_varchar_key
               Index Cond: (((col_varchar_key)::text >= 'c'::text) AND ((col_varchar_key)::text < 'd'::text))
               Storage Index Filter: ((((col_varchar_key)::text ~~ 'c%'::text) AND ((col_varchar_key)::text <> 'v'::text)) OR ((col_varchar_key)::text ~~ 'c%'::text) OR (col_varchar_key IS NULL))
         ->  Bitmap Index Scan on cc_int_datetime_varchar_key
               Index Cond: (col_varchar_key IS NULL)
(11 rows)
```
"postgres" processes before executing the query:
```
[mtakahara@mt-mbp-qmd6n randgen (master)]$ ps -ef|grep post
  501 27307 27298   0 10:42PM ??         0:00.00 postgres: logger
  501 27309 27298   0 10:42PM ??         0:00.03 postgres: YSQL webserver
  501 27310 27298   0 10:42PM ??         0:00.00 postgres: checkpointer
  501 27311 27298   0 10:42PM ??         0:00.00 postgres: stats collector
  501 27486 27298   0 10:46PM ??         0:00.19 postgres: yugabyte test 127.0.0.1(65066) idle
  501 27298 27195   0 10:42PM ttys001    0:02.15 /Users/mtakahara/code/yugabyte-db/build/latest/postgres/bin/postgres -D /Users/mtakahara/yugabyte-data/node-1/disk-1/pg_data -p 5433 -h 127.0.0.1 -k /tmp/.yb.127.0.0.1:5433 -c unix_socket_permissions=0700 -c logging_collector=on -c log_directory=/Users/mtakahara/yugabyte-data/node-1/disk-1/yb-data/tserver/logs -c yb_pg_metrics.node_name=mt-mbp-qmd6n:9000 -c yb_pg_metrics.port=13000 -c config_file=/Users/mtakahara/yugabyte-data/node-1/disk-1/pg_data/ysql_pg.conf -c hba_file=/Users/mtakahara/yugabyte-data/node-1/disk-1/pg_data/ysql_hba.conf -c ident_file=/Users/mtakahara/yugabyte-data/node-1/disk-1/pg_data/ysql_ident.conf
  501 27537 32006   0 10:47PM ttys002    0:00.00 grep post
```
after:
```
[mtakahara@mt-mbp-qmd6n randgen (master)]$ ps -ef|grep post
  501 27307     1   0 10:42PM ??         0:00.00 postgres: logger
  501 27486     1   0 10:46PM ??         0:00.34 postgres: yugabyte test 127.0.0.1(65066) SELECT
  501 27571 32006   0 10:47PM ttys002    0:00.00 grep post
```

Test Case
---
```
DROP DATABASE test;
CREATE DATABASE test WITH COLOCATION = ON;

\c test

CREATE TABLE t1 (    pk integer NOT NULL,    col_int_nokey integer,    col_varchar_key character varying(1),    CONSTRAINT t1_pkey PRIMARY KEY(pk ASC));


COPY t1 (pk, col_int_nokey, col_varchar_key) FROM stdin;
10	\N	x
11	8	d
12	1	r
13	9	f
14	4	y
15	3	u
16	2	m
17	\N	\N
18	2	o
19	\N	w
20	6	m
21	7	q
22	2	\N
23	5	d
24	7	g
25	6	x
26	6	f
27	2	p
28	9	j
29	6	c
\.


CREATE INDEX t1_col_varchar_key_idx ON t1 USING lsm (col_varchar_key ASC);


-- 10 sec timeout for bailing out of hang sooner. Not necessary to reproduce.
SET statement_timeout = 10000;


/*+ Set(enable_seqscan OFF) */
SELECT
    col_int_nokey
FROM
    t1
WHERE
    col_varchar_key LIKE 'c%'
    OR
    col_varchar_key IS NULL
;
```
